render.tilesManifestPrelude:
# openvms (slot 84) — TWO-VM DECwindows bridge. A captured 1024x768 Debian
#   bridge runs lean Xorg only (no Linux WM/DM) with usb-tablet. OpenVMS is an
#   independent SLIRP X client restored from leanx-preconnect, then replays the
#   DECterm/FileView/Clock/Calculator fixture. Reset is a cold service restart;
#   warm loadvm is forbidden because it restores dead X sockets.

museum.blurb: The durable VMS lineage on modern x86-64, presented as its classic network-transparent DECwindows Motif desktop.
museum.notes: A two-VM graphical bridge: OpenVMS supplies MWM and the applications while a private lean-X Debian guest supplies only the captured Xorg scanout and absolute tablet input.

reset.fixture: OpenVMS DECwindows Motif desktop at 1024x768 with DECterm at a DCL $ prompt, FileView, Clock, and Calculator. Cold service restart starts fresh Xorg and OpenVMS SLIRP processes, restores leanx-preconnect, and replays the fixture.

notes: graphical bridge is a new two-QEMU tile pattern: captured lean Xorg bridge plus OpenVMS network X client
Xorg -ac is reachable only behind QEMU host-loopback NAT at 127.0.0.1:6610
warm loadvm is forbidden because it restores dead X sockets; reset is a cold streamhost service restart
absolute pointer and keyboard are injected into the captured bridge; OpenVMS supplies DECW$MWM and all visible apps
